name: Air Defender
author: G Hancox
description: Closes your moving heads' shutters when low aircraft fly near your show. Gets flight data from adsb.fi or your own ADS-B receiver. Optional DeadZones also closes a head while it points into an area you mark out, like a neighbour's house or the road. It can only see aircraft that broadcast ADS-B, so think of it as an extra layer of safety, not a replacement for following the rules on lights pointed at the sky. Sends your show's location (rounded to about 1 km) to adsb.fi; only if you use them, to adsb.lol as a backup and to Open-Meteo to look up your ground elevation.

privacy.summary: Checks adsb.fi, a free flight-tracking service, for low aircraft near your show and closes your moving heads' shutters while one is close. Your show's location is sent to adsb.fi.

sends.what: an aircraft's callsign, from your browser
sends.why: only when you click FlightAware in an aircraft's details on the radar

sends.what: your show's location, rounded to about 1 km, and search radius
sends.why: to get the aircraft near your show, only if you choose it or turn it on as adsb.fi's backup

sends.what: your show's location, rounded to about 1 km, and search radius
sends.why: to get aircraft near your show (default service, or a backup you turn on), only while checking

sends.to: http://your own ADS-B receiver on your network
sends.what: a request for the aircraft it hears (no location)
sends.why: to check for aircraft without the internet, if you choose it
to look up the ground elevation there, only when you press Look it up in Settings

sends.to: http://the Player FPP on your network
sends.what: a request for its status, with the Player's UI password if you enter one
sends.why: so a Remote closes its heads when the Player does

collects.what: callsigns, distance and height of low aircraft that passed near your show
collects.where: plugin log (logs/plugin-AirDefender.log and rotated copies): Clear log on the dashboard empties it; uninstall deletes it

collects.what: the latest safety event, which can name the aircraft
collects.where: plugins/AirDefender/last_event.json: deleted by Clear log, and with the plugin folder on uninstall

collects.what: aircraft near the show right now, for the dashboard's radar
collects.where: memory (/dev/shm/AirDefender/state.json, or plugins/AirDefender/ if /dev/shm can't be used): replaced every check

collects.what: the Player's UI password, if you enter one on a Remote
collects.where: plugindata/AirDefender/ (owner-only): Remove in Settings deletes it; uninstall deletes it, a Reinstall keeps it

systemChanges.what: runs a background process while FPP is running, to watch for aircraft and control the shutters
holds the listed heads' shutter channels through fppd's channel overlays while an aircraft is near or during a test
a read-only status page on FPP's web server, which Remote FPPs on your network read
on FPP 10.0-10.2 only, sets FPP's restart-needed flag if an update can't reload the plugin
with DeadZones turned on, a part compiled at install runs inside fppd and closes a head's shutter while it points into an area you marked

privacy.other: The status page Remote FPPs read shares whether the heads are closed and why, and the latest event, which can name the aircraft. Uninstalling deletes everything Air Defender kept; a Reinstall keeps a Remote's saved Player password and your DeadZones zones. adsb.lol is sent the location only if you choose it or turn it on as a backup. With DeadZones turned on (it is off by default), a compiled part built at install runs inside fppd and closes a head's shutter in each frame while it points into an area you marked. Importing heads from xLights reads your xLights files in your browser only; nothing is sent anywhere.
